newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan dinar overnight rate rises to 8.49 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan dinar overnight rate rises to 8.49 pct.

text.p: The weighted average overnight interbank rate on the Jordanian dinar rose slightly to 8.49 percent on Thursday from 8.34 percent on Tuesday, the Central Bank said.
The Central Bank said eight banks traded on the market in 24 reported transactions with a total value of 27.75 million dinars ($39.2 million).
Jordanian banks along with government institutions were closed on Wednesday, a public holiday to mark New Year.
